result.summary: Found 2 visually broken issues: the bottom navigation highlights the wrong tab (Profile instead of Home) and the favorite heart icons have inconsistent backgrounds.

issues.description: Bottom navigation shows Profile as active (green) while the screen content is clearly the Home feed
issues.suggestion: Set the Home tab to active state when on the home feed and set Profile to inactive gray

issues.description: Favorite heart icon styling is inconsistent in Popular right now section: Tokumaru Ramen Bar heart has no background scrim while the pizza card below has a dark circular background
issues.suggestion: Apply a consistent dark circular scrim background to all favorite icons for visibility and consistency
